payload.core_mechanism_summary: Recursive DP with state (left_index, equal_flag, color_swap_flag) to count valid strings under reversal and color-swap symmetries, incrementally constructing the lexicographically smallest k-th string.
payload.rationale: The DP uses a single index dimension (left index l) with boolean flags, corresponding to dp_1d_state. It's not a true 2D DP as the right index is determined by symmetry.
